title: APAY Authority Grant v0.4
description: The framework-owned mandate for the agent-to-payment plane. Protocol mandates (AP2 Intent/Cart Mandates, Mastercard Agentic Tokens, KYA-OS delegations, x402 payment payloads) bind TO this object; none of them replace it. Defined in NEXUS/payments/README.md, control profile CP.5.APAY.

authority_grant_id.description: Stable identifier for this grant. Immutable after issuance.

delegation_chain_id.description: Lineage root shared by every grant in one authority tree. Revoking the chain severs all of them at once.

parent_grant_id.description: Immediate parent. Null only for a root grant. A non-null value naming a grant that does not exist is an orphan and must fail closed.

principal_id.description: The accountable principal. Revocation epochs are tracked per principal.

agent_did.description: DID of the agent holding this grant.

revocation_epoch.description: Monotonic counter carried from the principal at issuance. A grant whose epoch is below the principal's current epoch has no authority, regardless of its other fields. This is what makes revocation a single atomic act rather than a race against every cache.

instruction_ref.description: Reference to the principal's original natural-language instruction, retained so an adjudicator can inspect the translation rather than the agent's account of it.

normalized_constraints_digest.description: SHA-256 over the deterministic constraints derived from the instruction. Kept separate from instruction_digest so semantic-translation error is visible as a difference between two artifacts.

unresolved_ambiguities.description: Constraint axes the instruction did not determine. A grant with a non-empty list MUST NOT authorize spend. Unresolved ambiguity is never closed by a model.

approved_by.description: Identity that approved the rendered mandate on a trusted surface.

approval_surface.description: Digest of exactly what was rendered at approval time. Generated from constraints, never from agent-supplied prose.

capabilities.description: Separation of duties (APAY-07). A grant that can execute a payment does not thereby hold refund or account-management authority.

grant_digest.description: SHA-256 over the grant's authority-bearing fields.

minor_units.description: Exact minor units. Never a float: accumulated floating-point error in a spend ceiling is precisely the signal a micro-drain attack hides inside.

constraints.description: Every field is an attenuation axis. A null set-valued field means UNCONSTRAINED on that axis, which is why a child holding null under a constrained parent is a widening, not an inheritance.

max_aggregate.description: Ceiling across this grant AND every descendant. Evaluated on the subtree, not on the grant alone.

denied_merchants.description: A child may never forget a parent's deny list.

allowed_destinations.description: Payee or settlement addresses. On an irreversible rail, a null value is unbounded liability rather than convenience.

min_assurance.description: 0 none/guest, 1 bearer, 2 signed request (Web Bot Auth / Visa TAP class), 3 mandate bound to a cart (AP2 class), 4 mandate plus fresh workload measurement. The CP.5.APAY floor is 4. An execution path offering less is refused, which is what prevents an agent from escaping controls by choosing guest checkout.

max_finality.description: Strongest settlement finality this grant tolerates. May tighten down the tree, never loosen.

max_delegation_depth.description: REMAINING sub-delegation budget, decremented at every hop. A grant holding zero cannot mint children.

hear_above.description: Spend at or above this requires named human authority (AI SAFE2 CP.10 HEAR).
